review_note: Second-round review confirmed r1 fixes and found two remaining failure paths. Both fixed with negative-first evidence; T04a stays READY_FOR_ACCEPTANCE until independent review confirms this round.

findings_fixed.finding: Windows Job creation/configuration/assignment failures were silently ignored: unchecked AssignProcessToJobObject BOOL meant an unattributed run was reported completed with no descendant reclamation guarantee
findings_fixed.fix: _WindowsJob declares explicit ctypes prototypes and checks CreateJobObjectW, SetInformationJobObject, AssignProcessToJobObject, TerminateJobObject, recording GetLastError diagnostics in .error; execute refuses to create any resource when the job is unavailable (infra_error before spawn); payloads start CREATE_SUSPENDED and are attributed (or terminated while still suspended, so no descendant ever runs) before threads resume - this also removes the r1 assignment race

findings_fixed.finding: lifecycle exception handling covered only Popen OSError: log open failures and reclamation helper failures raised bare exceptions, leaving the payload directory and producing no WorkerOutcome; mkdir/env build were outside the guarded zone and log read-back depended on already-failing paths
findings_fixed.fix: unified _InfraFailure lifecycle: mkdir, log open, process start, reclamation (taskkill/killpg OSError and timeout) and log read-back all convert to structured infra_error outcomes with the primary reason and cleanup; reclamation failure reports the unreclaimed state instead of a completed run

verification.repro_before_fix: 5/5 r2 repro tests failed on unfixed code
